data.action: 裹好浴巾坐在水下石阶，一手扶尾巴，另一手扶石阶。
data.description: 夜间温泉里，铃兰裹好不透明白色浴巾，坐在水下石阶上，一手扶住浮起的尾巴，另一手扶着石阶。灯笼倒影在蒸汽与水波间轻晃。
data.promptProse: Securely wrapped in an opaque white towel, Suzuran sits on a submerged stone step, one hand steadying a floating tail, the other supporting her on the step; lantern reflections ripple through steam.
data.title: 铃兰 · 温泉休憩
data.animaCaption: Her opaque towel stays securely wrapped as one hand steadies a tail and one supports her on the step.
